title: Editing claims, hedging and register
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply editing claims, hedging and register in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 编辑过度绝对化的议论文，让语域正式但不空泛。
grammar: all/always/inevitably 需要非常强的证据；may、often、in some contexts 可校准范围，但不能在每句机械堆叠。正式语体优先准确具体而非夸饰。
common_mistake: 把坏论证写得更复杂不会提高证据质量。

examples.text: The first draft claimed that social media inevitably destroys genuine friendship.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: This statement combines an absolute outcome with an undefined standard of genuineness.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: A more defensible claim is that some patterns of use may displace time for face-to-face contact.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: The revision identifies a possible mechanism and narrows the scope.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: The first draft claimed that social media inevitably destroys genuine friendship. This statement combines an absolute outcome with an undefined standard of genuineness. A more defensible claim is that some patterns of use may displace time for face-to-face contact. The revision identifies a possible mechanism and narrows the scope. It also leaves room for online communication to sustain relationships across distance. Formal writing does not require the writer to avoid a position. It requires the strength and range of that position to match the reasons offered in its support.
listening_script: The first draft claimed that social media inevitably destroys genuine friendship. This statement combines an absolute outcome with an undefined standard of genuineness. A more defensible claim is that some patterns of use may displace time for face-to-face contact. The revision identifies a possible mechanism and narrows the scope. It also leaves room for online communication to sustain relationships across distance. Formal writing does not require the writer to avoid a position. It requires the strength and range of that position to match the reasons offered in its support.
listening_label: 原创文本脚本；可用设备 TTS 练习，未配对真人或教材音频

questions.prompt: Which word makes the initial claim absolute ?
questions.explanation: 必然性排除了所有例外，原稿没有提供相应证据。

questions.prompt: Why is the revised claim more precise ?
questions.answer: It specifies some patterns, a possible effect and a mechanism.
questions.explanation: 不是单纯添加 may，而是明确对象与作用。

pronunciation: sentence stress; connected speech; intelligibility without a total score。先按意群朗读，再用选词面板练习；浏览器转写不能证明音素正确。
production: Produce an original spoken explanation plus a written reflection demonstrating editing claims, hedging and register
self_review: 核对任务是否回答完整、信息是否有原文证据、目标结构是否准确。记录一次修改及理由；开放题允许不同的有据答案，不计算官方等级分数。
